jobs.name: Jiang Zemin
jobs.reference_note: Chinese State Archives/Xinhua gallery identifies the reference as Jiang speaking at the 23–24 June 1989 CPC plenum. Reference photographs are not shipped; pose and colors are artistic interpretations. Party title does not establish PRC presidency.
jobs.prompt: Create one polished 2D CARTOON full-body avatar of Jiang Zemin circa 1990. IMAGE 1 is approved STYLE ONLY: match its bold dark clean ink outlines, expressive simplified facial features, flat graphic cel shading, slightly enlarged head and about 5.5-head adult body proportions. IMAGE 2 is the exact June 1989 IDENTITY reference. Chinese man in his early sixties, high forehead, short straight dark-grey hair combed smoothly back with a side part, very large thick black square spectacles with rounded lower corners, broad rounded face, heavy cheeks and full neck, flat broad nose, clean shaven and composed expression. Medium stocky build. Grey Zhongshan suit with upright collar and four flap pockets, matching trousers, black plain shoes. Stand slightly three-quarter toward viewer, one relaxed hand and one holding a closed slim dark folder. Do not include political badge, name tag, microphones, tables, cups, flags, text or other people from reference. Preserve recognizable identity cues while rendering the face as a clearly drawn cartoon, no photographic skin detail. Full head, hands and shoes visible with comfortable margins; perfectly flat opaque dark teal background #192D34 with no vignette or halo. Portrait 1024x1536. No labels, slogans, watermark, checkerboard, photorealism, painterly texture or plastic 3D render.
